newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sales tax hike won't lead to inflation - BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Sales tax hike won't lead to inflation - BOJ quoted.

text.p: The planned rise in Japan's consumption tax next April will not lead to lasting inflation, although prices may rise temporarily, Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita was quoted as saying on Wednesday.
Matsushita made the remarks at a closed-door meeting of a private research group in Tokyo.
He said the drop in Japan's public works spending would not have any negative effect on the nation's gross domestic product (GDP).

Takafumi Noshi, one of the organisers of the meeting, quoted the central bank chief as saying the drop would be reflected in the GDP figure, but since the majority of GDP consists of private consumption and other items, the overall impact of the drop in public works spending on GDP would be minimal.
